_about: Public prices of the platforms the finance engine can recommend. Read by engine/scripts/pick_platforms.py. Prices excl. VAT unless noted; gbp null = not recorded yet, the picker says 'check'.

tinytax_solo.note: 1 trading company: CT600 + Companies House accounts. Was £59 (Oct 2026); on 2026-11-10 the page showed £69 or £79 to different visitors (price test), higher figure used

informdirect_payg_cs.note: pay-as-you-go confirmation statement, plus Companies House fee

ch_confirmation_statement.note: Companies House statutory fee; file direct on Companies House (TinyTax CS01 is £74 incl. this fee)

simplecompanytax_cic.note: active micro-entity (FRS 105), unlimited filings a year: CT600 filed to HMRC + accounts; for a CIC, CIC34 + Companies House package ZIP (CH £15 fee separate). Dormant £10

hmrc_basic_paye_tools.note: HMRC's free payroll software, fewer than 10 employees. Sends RTI only: no payslip printing (save as PDF), no auto-enrolment assessment or pension files, desktop, no API

xero_ignite.note: Ignite list price after the 6-month intro discount (£1.80/month for months 1-6); non-profit discounts exist. Grow £39, Comprehensive £55

ch_webfiling_micro.note: no Companies House fee for filing accounts (CIC package excepted)

primo_essentials_free.note: Primo Payroll Essentials (free, with adverts): up to 10 employees incl. leavers, RTI, payslip emailing; auto-enrolment module shown on the plan but not confirmed in text; no public API. Checked 2026-11-10

primo_essentials_50.note: Primo Payroll Essentials 50: as free plan, no adverts, email + phone support

staffology_payroll.note: IRIS Staffology Payroll: cloud, open API (API-first), RTI, payslips, auto-enrolment. Price unclear: vendor/review figures range £10/month + payslips (minimum £35/month) to £43/month; confirm on staffology.co.uk. Re-checked 2026-11-10: pricing page is script-only, no figure readable

xero_payroll.note: per person per month on Ignite (Grow includes 1 person, Ultimate 10); needs a Xero plan; API; RTI, payslips, auto-enrolment
